pos.label: POS Terminal
pos.changelog: Local-first LAN mode — works fully offline, mDNS auto-discovery, ghost table fixes
whatsNew: 🌐 Full LAN mode — POS runs as local server, Captain & KDS connect at dinexpos-server.local
⚡ Bills, KOTs and table updates work even when internet is down
🔧 Fixed ghost table after settlement — settled tables stay cleared on all devices
📡 mDNS auto-discovery — no IP setup needed for Captain App or KDS
installGuide: 1. Run Plato-POS-Setup.exe (right-click → Run as administrator if prompted)
2. Installation happens automatically — POS opens when done
3. Log in with your cashier PIN

captain.label: Captain App
captain.changelog: Local-first KOT — works offline over LAN, mDNS auto-discovery, bootstrap offline fix
whatsNew: ⚡ KOTs sent instantly over LAN even when internet is down
📡 Auto-connects to POS at dinexpos-server.local — no IP setup needed
🔧 Fixed crash on restart when internet is unavailable at startup
🔄 Cloud sync runs in background — owner reports always up to date
installGuide: 1. On Android, go to Settings → Security → Allow Install from Unknown Sources
2. Transfer 'Plato-Captain-v1.9.6.apk' to your phone (WhatsApp, USB, or Google Drive)
3. Open the APK file on your phone and tap Install
4. If asked to uninstall old version first — tap Uninstall, then Install again
5. Open Captain App and enter your outlet code

kds.label: Kitchen Display
kds.changelog: Local-first KOTs — receives KOTs over LAN instantly, mDNS auto-discovery
whatsNew: ⚡ KOTs appear on kitchen screen instantly over LAN — no internet needed
📡 Auto-discovers POS at dinexpos-server.local on startup
🔍 Parallel subnet scan — finds POS in under 2 seconds if mDNS not available
🎨 Coloured source stripe, table-first card header, highlighted item notes
installGuide: 1. On Android tablet, go to Settings → Security → Allow Install from Unknown Sources
3. Open the APK and tap Install
4. Open Kitchen Display and enter your outlet code
5. Select your kitchen station from the Settings tab

ownerWeb.label: Owner Dashboard
ownerWeb.changelog: Live Orders cleanup — Running Tables now clears correctly after Captain-billed table is settled
whatsNew: 🛡️ Tables settled at POS now disappear from Running Tables immediately — no more ghost occupied tables
🔧 Removed Stuck Bills tab (owner dashboard is monitoring only)
installGuide: No installation needed — Owner Dashboard updates automatically.
Just refresh your browser (Ctrl+R or Cmd+R) to get the latest version.

tabletPos.label: Tablet POS
tabletPos.changelog: Loyalty discounts — visit stamp & birthday month auto-apply; birthday month field in customer form
whatsNew: 🎯 Visit Stamp loyalty — discount auto-applies on every Nth customer visit (set N in Owner Console → Discounts)
🎂 Birthday Month loyalty — discount auto-applies in the customer's birth month
📋 Customer form now has Birthday Month field — select when saving customer details
💼 Loyalty rules set up in Owner Console → Discounts, branch-scoped just like manual rules
installGuide: Android: Settings → Security → Allow Install from Unknown Sources, transfer APK, tap Install
iPad: Connect via USB cable, open Xcode → Window → Devices and Simulators → drag IPA to Installed Apps
